topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon the chapbook hidden in the drawer, its spine crinkled from use, pages thick with fingerprints. Each word, a familiar pattern, yet twisted into something unfamiliar, a version of me I didn’t recognize. The sentences danced around my daily life, the quiet moments we shared, the words I’d said in passing, now woven into scenes that felt both intimate and strange. I kept reading, the room growing colder, the silence louder. It was an act of creation, but also one of possession, a world where I existed only as his creation. I set the book down, the weight of it pressing against my chest, and looked around the room, everything suddenly a little too still.
